context: A quiet community library on a Wednesday afternoon. The retired professor reads a picture book aloud to a small circle of children; one of them keeps interrupting with sincere questions.
purpose: gentle instructional warmth — building curiosity in a child

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: では、続きを読みますよ。
lines.style: Low, weathered voice with warmth underneath. Careful, deliberate pace—the measured rhythm of someone who has read aloud for decades. A small, genuine smile audible at the edges.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 先生、その鳥、本当に話せるの？
lines.en: Sensei, can that bird really talk?
lines.style: Bright, genuinely curious interruption. Voice lifts on the question mark—no performance, just pure eight-year-old wonder. Leans slightly forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お話の中ではね。本当のことかは、君が決めていい。
lines.en: In the story, yes. Whether it's really true—you get to decide that.
lines.style: Slow and considered. He honors the question as if it were asked by an adult. Steady eye-contact level throughout. A slight pause before the second sentence, giving it weight.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: そっか…じゃあ、話せることにする！
lines.en: Oh—so I'll decide it can talk!
lines.style: A small breath of sudden understanding. Decisive and certain in the way only a child can be. Ends with quiet excitement, not performed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: いい判断ですね。続きが楽しみになる。
lines.en: That's a wise decision. It makes the rest of the story more interesting.
lines.style: Quiet approval delivered without condescension. Treats her choice as genuinely important. Warm nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: うん！その次、どうなるの？
lines.style: Leans forward eagerly. Barely containing energy. Already bouncing slightly in the seat, voice quick with anticipation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: それは、読んでからのお楽しみ。
lines.en: That's the fun of finding out—by reading on.
lines.style: A small, knowing chuckle underneath. The deliberate withholding of a practiced storyteller. Playful but not teasing. A slight twinkle of mischief.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 早く読んで、おじいちゃん先生！
lines.style: Affectionate demand wrapped in laughter. The improvised honorific lands as genuine warmth and compliment. Voice almost giggling, full of comfortable affection.
